description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) 'LeaveRequestSearchFilterParams' used to encapsulate filtering parameters for querying leave requests within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It extends from a date range filter class and includes various filtering options such as statuses, employee number(s), subunit ID, leave type, and inclusion criteria for employees. The class includes methods for setting and retrieving these parameters, as well as validation to ensure statuses are valid.

classes.name: LeaveRequestSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for encapsulating search filter parameters for leave requests, including status filters, employee identifiers, subunit, leave type, and inclusion options, with validation logic.

methods.name: getStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves the array of leave statuses set for filtering.

methods.name: setStatuses
methods.description: Sets the leave statuses for filtering after validating they are within allowed statuses.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers used in filtering.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getSubunitId
methods.description: Returns the subunit ID filter value.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the leave type ID filter value.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID filter.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves the inclusion criteria for employees.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the inclusion criteria for employees.
